thread:
Alex W: Quick check — how should the API pick the model when a request includes both `model_pin` and `routing_hints.region` (and possibly `tier`)? Specifically: precedence, fallback behavior when the pinned model isn't available in the hinted region, and what we must guarantee in the response shape for backward compatibility.

Maria C: My take: pin should win if the pinned model is deployable in the chosen region/tier. If not deployable (capacity or not uploaded), we fall back to routing hints. We must not remove or rename existing fields — prefer adding `requested_model` + `fallback_reason` rather than changing `served_model`. :thinking:

Jordan P: Sounds good. Suggested precedence: 1) explicit `model_pin` if available 2) variant/model choices inferred from `routing_hints` (region/tier) 3) region fallback rules (same tier, nearest region) 4) global default model. If we do a fallback because the pin isn't deployable, return 409 with a machine-readable `fallback_info` object and include `requested_model` in the response so clients can detect the original intent. Example request:```json
{ "model_pin": "rw-13b-qat-v2", "routing_hints": { "region": "eu-west-1", "tier": "high" } }
```

Sasha: +1, but remember pin TTL behavior. We already have `pin_ttl` for ephemeral pins — when pin expires we should treat it as absent. Also, for API contract: adding `fallback_reason` (string enum) and `requested_model` is fine; existing clients will ignore extra fields. DO NOT rename `served_model` -> `served_model_id` (that would be a breaking change).

Alex W: Agreed. To be explicit about response shape (back-compat): keep `served_model` (string), add optional `requested_model` (string), optional `fallback_info` (object serialized as JSON string for now to avoid schema drift), and optional `routing_decision` tag. Example response sketches:```json
{ "served_model": "rw-7b-qat-v1", "requested_model": "rw-13b-qat-v2", "routing_decision": "fallback_to_variant", "fallback_info": "{\"reason\":\"unavailable_in_region\",\"region_tried\":\"eu-west-1\"}" }
```

Maria C: One nit — prefer `fallback_info` as a flat string field for now so older telemetry parsers don't break, but add explicit tests. Also add a code comment that we will transition it to a first-class object in a later API minor version.

deploy-bot: PR created by alexw -> /pr/3421: "model selection precedence + fallback_info in responses". Includes spec docs + unit tests.

routing-bot: heads up: `pin_region_override` routing flag is currently disabled in prod. Flipping it will change behavior for customers who pin cross-region. Recommend canary.

Jordan P: Can we add an integration test that simulates pinned model absent from a region? Expectation: 409 status, `requested_model` present, `served_model` points to fallback, and metric `routing_decision=fallback_to_variant`. I'll add the test to the routing test matrix.

Sasha: Also document streaming envelope for this case: streaming chunk metadata should include `served_model` on the first chunk so clients can correlate tokens with model used.

Alex W: Good catch. I'll update the PR with example streaming envelope and the integration test plan. Plan to canary the routing flag and PR tomorrow in eu-west-1 only. If nobody objects I'll merge after reviews. @Maria C @Jordan P can you review the spec and tests? :pleading_face:

Maria C: I'll review later today and leave comments.

Jordan P: Reviewing now, will leave CR comments in the PR. :+1:

Alex W: Thanks all — will post a follow-up when the canary is scheduled.

Maria C: :thumbsup:

Jordan P: :rocket:
